metadata.title: Density Pass 28 -- The Railroad Cut: Davis's Brigade Disaster (Ticks 20-35)
metadata.description: Davis's Mississippi brigade captures the Unfinished Railroad Cut north of the Chambersburg Pike but advances too far into an unfinished cut too deep to escape. The 6th Wisconsin charges in from the flank. 232 Mississippians captured, the regimental flag taken. A complete tactical disaster turned into a Union victory in minutes.

placements.notes: 2nd Mississippi advancing north of the pike -- Davis's brigade pushing forward
55th NC on Davis's left -- pushing toward the railroad cut
Cutler's brigade -- taking heavy fire from Davis. Cutler ordered to fall back.
2nd MS in the Railroad Cut -- the cut is 9 feet deep here. They cannot get out to pursue.
42nd MS also in the cut -- celebrating having driven Cutler back. Not noticing the 6th Wisconsin forming.
6th Wisconsin forming for the charge -- Dawes will lead them diagonally into Davis's exposed flank
6th Wisconsin CHARGING -- moving at the double-quick across the open field toward the cut
95th NY and 14th Brooklyn joining the 6th Wisconsin's charge on the railroad cut
2nd MS TRAPPED in the cut -- 6th Wisconsin firing down from the rim. Survivors surrendering.
42nd MS trying to escape the cut -- 232 Mississippi men will surrender here
6th Wisconsin at the cut rim -- hand-to-hand fighting. Corporal Francis Waller captures the 2nd MS flag.
55th NC retreating -- Davis's brigade collapsing. The railroad cut will cost Davis 600 casualties.
2nd Mississippi survivors -- 232 captured, flag lost. Same men who will fight at The Angle on July 3.
6th Wisconsin holding the cut -- 232 prisoners, 1 battle flag. Dawes's finest hour.
Davis reforming behind Herr Ridge -- down to half strength, his brigade will not recover today
